chunks: And when Paradise is brought near,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Paradise is brought near in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the immediate and tangible nature of divine reward, contrasting the spiritual proximity of Paradise for the righteous with the distance of Hell for the wicked. It underscores the concept of 'Qurb' (closeness) as a metaphysical reality realized on the Day of Resurrection, affirming the justice of Allah in granting eternal bliss to those who maintained piety.
